title: File:Rang-ghar.JPG
author: Hiranmoy Boruah
description: Rang-ghar,Sivasagar, it was built by ahom king PRAMATTA SINGHA. It is said that the kings of the Ahom dynasty used to watch different sports from here. It is a two-story structure. This pavilion is oval in shape.
period_note: Surviving masonry predominantly 18th century; not direct evidence for a 15th-century palace
